transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Hi Priya, let's walk through your monetization roadmap for HealthMatch.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Currently, all 800 therapists on our site are on a legacy free tier. We need to transition them to a paid recurring subscription model starting next month.

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Understood. What payment provider are you planning to use, and what membership tiers do you need?

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: We already have a verified business Stripe account. We want three tiers: Free Basic, Professional at $49/month, and Clinic VIP at $149/month with featured homepage placement.

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Brilliant Directories has native Stripe integration that supports 3D Secure verification, recurring billing webhooks, and automatic downgrades on payment failure. We can configure that directly via the Payment Settings.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: What about invoice receipts? Our therapists need branded PDF tax receipts for their business expenses whenever a monthly payment clears.

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: We can enable automated email invoice receipts configured with your clinic branding and tax identification numbers.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: And if someone wants to cancel, can they do it directly from their member dashboard without having to email support?

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Yes, we can enable the member self-service subscription cancellation setting so members can manage their billing without manual administrative overhead.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Excellent. We need this tested and launched in 3 weeks.
